A portable business-driven shell that's a workstation-grade beast under the hood.

design_philosophy: The 90Hz-panel variant of the max-capacity P14s Gen 6 CAD starter: same RTX PRO 500 + 64GB + 2TB formula as the sibling config around a smoother-refresh display, trading vPro and a hair of battery for scroll/viewport smoothness at a slightly lower street price.
